## About
Buri Buri Plumbing is a full service plumbing company in South San Francisco, run by Rich, the owner. Our mission is simple: quality, efficient workmanship backed by honesty and integrity.
We work on single family homes and multi-unit dwellings, H.O.A. properties, retirement and assisted living homes, hospital environments and commercial properties. Old house or new building, our plumbers are Union trained and ready for any and all plumbing issues.
Neighbors on the Peninsula have given us a 4.8 rating from 26 Google reviews. One customer put it this way: their work holds up.

## Services
- Water Heaters: Repair and replacement when your water heater quits.
- Tankless water heater Service: Service for tankless water heaters.
- Sewer line repair replacement: Sewer line problems are not pretty, but we have the staff and resources to help.
- Drain line repair & replacement: Fixing and replacing drain lines in homes and commercial buildings.
- Water line repair & replacement: Repair or replacement of the water line to your home or building.
- Line inspection and camera: A camera look inside the line so we can see the problem before we fix it.
- Sump pump & Sewer Ejectors: Service for sump pumps and sewer ejectors.
- Faucet repair & replacement: Leaky or worn out faucets repaired or replaced.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer emergency service?
A: Yes. We offer 24 hour emergency services.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. We are fully licensed and insured, and our plumbers are Union trained.

Q: Do you work on older homes?
A: Yes. Whether your home or building went up 100 years ago or in recent years, we are here for you.

Q: What are your office hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Overall I'm please with the work. Note that the price is not inexpensive but is fair so if you are looking for the cheapest plumber this is not it.
